title.narrative: Resettlement from Turkey and Middle East

description.narrative: Through this project, IOM provides transportation and other assistance to refugees from Turkey and the Middle East for resettlement to the United States of America. These activities are part of the United States Refugee Admissions Program (USRAP) and fall under the memorandum of understanding between the State Department/Bureau of Population, Refugees, and Migration (BPRM) and IOM.
